titulo.alumno: Who does what? · Public documents and decisions

intro: Part 3: who does what. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: In a public document, locate the authority, the decision, the date it takes effect, the people affected and the appeal available. Nominal style condenses actions; identify who must carry them out.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
